hooks.name: Typecheck on Stop
hooks.description: Runs typecheck across all packages after agent execution completes, reporting errors as a concise list or confirming clean status

action.command:
bash -c '
# Run typecheck across all packages
output=$(pnpm -r typecheck 2>&1)
exit_code=$?

if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Typecheck clean"
  exit 0
fi

# Parse errors and summarize
echo "TypeScript errors:"
echo ""

# Extract file:line:column and error message patterns
echo "$output" | grep -E "^[^:]+\([0-9]+,[0-9]+\):|^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[0-9]+:" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  # Try to extract file, line, and message
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^([^:]+):([0-9]+):([0-9]+):(.*)$ ]]; then
    file="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    line_num="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    message=$(echo "${BASH_REMATCH[4]}" | sed "s/^[[:space:]]*//" | head -c 100)
    echo "- $file:$line_num: $message"
  elif [[ "$line" =~ ^([^(]+)\(([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\):(.*)$ ]]; then
    file="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    line_num="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    message=$(echo "${BASH_REMATCH[4]}" | sed "s/^[[:space:]]*//" | head -c 100)
    echo "- $file:$line_num: $message"
  fi
done | head -n 20

exit 0
'
